lead.headline: Lost 125-71; Tuten's ankle 'not too bad', Metcalf not suspended
lead.deck: Every AVIATO starter has played; 4-7. Diggs on the bench is all that is left.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten re-aggravated his ankle against the Giants (Coen, Monday) and scored 8.3; Likely caught one pass, Warren had 4.9 and Allen threw two interceptions. AVIATO finish on 71.16 to Panda Attack's 125.2, the projection lineup with about 4.9 points on the bench before Diggs plays tonight. Two Monday rulings help Week 12: Coen said Tuten's re-check 'wasn't too bad' with a decision on Friday, and the NFL will not suspend Metcalf, who plays Denver on Friday. The Tuesday 16:00 run is the last before claims process Wednesday 02:00 CDMX.
